measurement_note: Size is n, the binary-string length. The legal 28-, 56-, and 112-character tiers span 4x. Each string contains a zero prefix of length n/2 and an alternating suffix, with no flips allowed, so the answer is n/2. The accepted method binary-searches the answer over a precomputed run list; a correct slower baseline tests candidate limits consecutively from one.
